Failure to disclose this information shall result in cancellation of the bidder’s participation. Scope of Supply The successful bidder shall supply, deliver, install, test and commission one brand-new, unuse d and current-production PVC ID Card Printer suitable for printing employee identity cards at ESIC Model Hospital, Ludhiana. The supply shall include standard accessories, power adapter/cable, required connectivity cabl es, printer drivers, card-design software or applicable licence, user manual, cleaning kit and st arter consumables required for initial operation. The printer shall be suitable for printing colo ur photographs, ESIC logo, employee name, designation, department, employee identification number and barcode/QR code where supported. Each printed PVC ID card shall have a hologram to be provided by this office affixed to it after printing. The hologram shall be securely attached to each card to ensure durability and resista nce to easy removal or tampering.

Installation,Commissioning and Demonstration The supplier shall install, configure and commission the printer at ESIC Model Hospital, Ludhia na. The supplier shall demonstrate successful printing of sample PVC cards containing text, ph otographs and logos, and barcodes/QR codes where supported. Installation, driver configurati on and basic user training shall be provided without additional charges. The GeM bid provides 20 days for ICT after communication of site readiness. Payment allocation stated in the bid is 70% on product delivery and a minimum 30% cost allocation for I CT; payment shall remain subject to the GeM bid and contract terms. .
